caption:
Push-ups: the only workout where you lose an argument with the floor and somehow get stronger.

Free, works most of your upper body, and scales from "leaning on a wall" to "telling everyone about it". Start wherever your ego can handle.

Send this to the brother who's been "starting Monday" since 2022.

Heart stat: Yang et al., JAMA Network Open, 2019. Study of male firefighters; it shows a link, not cause and effect. Not medical advice.
